item.title: One Man’s Trash Is Another Man’s Felony
item.description: Read One Man’s Trash Is Another Man’s Felony Caller: "Stop whatever you're doing!" Me: "What was that?" Caller: "Your trash guys took one of my trash bags, but it was a mistake! It wasn't supposed to be taken!" Read One Man’s Trash Is Another Man’s Felony

item.title: A Catalogue Of Complaints
item.description: Read A Catalogue Of Complaints Customer: "My sister passed. She ordered from you for years. We cleared out a whole bedroom. I want refunds." Me: "I’m very sorry for your loss. Let me start scanning and see what’s in the system." Read A Catalogue Of Complaints

item.title: The Pizza Gods Smile Kindly On You Tonight… And Tomorrow
item.description: Read The Pizza Gods Smile Kindly On You Tonight… And Tomorrow When we got back to her friend's, where she was staying just after midnight, we were hungry and craving pizza, so we put in an online order at a pizza place that was open late. However, after we paid, the order tracker said that our pizza wouldn't arrive until about 5 pm that evening. Read The Pizza Gods Smile Kindly On You Tonight… And Tomorrow

item.title: When They Wear Their Sunday Best, Expect The Sunday Worst, Part 4
item.description: Read When They Wear Their Sunday Best, Expect The Sunday Worst, Part 4 Customer: "—Are you discriminating against us because we came from the church?" Me: "Sir, look inside the diner. You see those two hundred plus customers? They're almost all from local churches. Does this look discriminatory to you?" Customer: "So then how come they all got booths?" Read When They Wear Their Sunday Best, Expect The Sunday Worst, Part 4

item.title: An Icy Reception From This State
item.description: Read An Icy Reception From This State Customer: "Why did the bathroom faucet water make my hands all red?!" Me: "Ma'am, did you let the water warm up before wetting your hands?" Customer: "No! It was freezing!" Read An Icy Reception From This State
